topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The air shifts, carrying the scent of unfamiliar blooms, their vibrant hues standing stark against the muted forest palette. No whisper of scent follows them, no trail to trace back, just the looming mystery of their arrival. Shadows dance at the edge of my vision, and the forest grows quieter, as if holding its breath. The usual rustle of leaves, the soft padding of feet on the forest floor, all muted by the presence of these silent, unspoken gifts. My paws twitch, ready to flee or fight, as the darkness feels closer, the edges of the world narrowing to this moment, this place, where the unexpected has taken root without warning or reason.
